description: This PHP class defines a data transfer object (DTO) for filtering employee language search results in the OrangeHRM system. It extends a base FilterParams class and includes properties for employee number and language IDs, along with corresponding getters and setters.

classes.name: EmployeeLanguagesSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A DTO class used for filtering employee languages based on employee number and language IDs, with sorting enabled on the 'l.name' field.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the filter parameters with default sorting on 'l.name'.

methods.name: getEmpNumber
methods.description: Returns the employee number being filtered.

methods.name: setEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the employee number for filtering.

methods.name: getLanguageIds
methods.description: Returns the list of language IDs being filtered.

methods.name: setLanguageIds
methods.description: Sets the list of language IDs for filtering.
